notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Torchling by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
